sources.title: LFM2.5 350M - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-350M is an upgraded 350M-parameter model built on Liquid AI's LFM2 architecture, with additional pretraining scaled from 10T to 28T tokens plus large-scale reinforcement learning. It is aimed at efficient edge and production deployment, with support across engines such as llama.cpp, MLX, vLLM, SGLang, ONNX, and OpenVINO.

sources.title: LFM2.5-350M: No Size Left Behind — Blog — Liquid AI
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-350M: No Size Left Behind Today, we're releasing LFM2.5-350M, an improved version of our 350M model with additional pre-training (from 10T to 28T tokens) and large-scale reinforcement learning. Built on the LFM2 architecture, it delivers exceptionally fast inference and runs everywhere, from cloud GPUs to cheap CPUs.
